origin.townstead_roots.ancestry.human.ba: The most common ancestry, found in every corner of the world. Humans are adaptable and resilient, with a wide range of appearances and cultures.
origin.townstead_roots.origin.overworlde: A native of the surface world, born to a settlement under open sky. Used to the sun and the rain, the overworlder is a hardy soul with a strong connection to the land.
gene.townstead_roots.human_thermal.desc: Rests at 37.0 °C with a narrow comfort band. Works up warmth, loses it in the wet and the wind, and dresses for winter.
gene.townstead_roots.human_life_cycle.de: Ages through baby, child, teen, adult, and senior stages at a human pace.
gene.townstead_roots.immortal.desc: Ageless, and cannot be killed by any worldly harm.
gene.townstead_roots.cannibal.desc: Will eat the flesh of their own kind, where the world allows it.
gene.townstead_roots.vampire_faint_pallo: Skin starts to lose its color.
gene.townstead_roots.vampire_glowing_eye: Red eyes that glow in the dark.
gene.townstead_roots.vampire_sun_weaknes: Weakened in direct sunlight unless wearing a hat or helmet.
gene.townstead_roots.vampire_sun_burn.de: Catches fire in direct sunlight unless wearing a hat or helmet.
gene.townstead_roots.vampire_diet.desc: Feeds on the blood of raw meat instead of eating food.
gene.townstead_roots.vampire_ageless.des: Stops aging, but can still be killed.
gene.townstead_roots.vampire_thermal.des: Heat and cold no longer affect them.
